main_text.head: PSALMVS IIII. CONSTAT
IX. versibus Heb. totidem Latinis.
main_text.p:
1. Annue, iuste Deus vindex, & in arctare-
Me spatioso coniice campo. (dactum

2. Siccine, primates, istud conuellere sceptrum
Deque throno exturbare paratis?

3. Spe vana illecti fingentes somnia vobis
Cur sputum eiectatis in astra?

4. Noscite ad extremum quod me Deus ipse per-
unxit,
Me vestris praefecit habenis.

5. Du locus est venia, heu! respipiscite, ponite rixas
In vestro haec expendite lecto.

6. Confisi Domino lectas ingulate bidentes,
Omne nefas holocausta piabunt.

7. Multi aiunt, quando exoptato Rege fruentur?
Tu radios Deus iniice puros.

8. At fuit annona me principe copia larga,
Farre, oleo, vinoque refertis.

9. Nunc in utraque aure composita pace quiesca:
Iure meo dominabor in aula.

page.notes: The verse "1. Annue ... (dactum" is cut off in the scan at the line end; the word after "(dactum" is not legible and the parenthetical is likely the title of a tune ("dactum" read with [?]). Line 4 "unxit," is set on its own line; line 5 "heu! respipiscite" and "lecto" read with some uncertainty. Ornament at the foot is not printed text and is omitted. Several word-ends in the verse are faint; read as printed but not all letters are certain.
